U.S. AIR FORCE AFSC 1C1X1

1C1X1 Air Traffic Control

ASVAB score requirements, what the job involves, and how to raise the scores that count

Minimum ASVAB score

  • G 55 and TAPAS 2-factor 55 and TAPAS 37

Minimum AFQT

31

What a 1C1X1 Does

Air Traffic Controllers direct aircraft on the ground and in the air around Air Force bases and deployed airfields. You will issue clearances, keep aircraft safely separated, and handle emergencies using radar and radio. The job demands clear speech, quick decisions, and a calm head, and it leads to a Federal Aviation Administration controller certificate.

Scores That Count for 1C1X1

  • G (General) = AR + VE. Study: Arithmetic Reasoning, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension

MAGE scores are percentiles: a G of 55 means you scored as well as or better than 55 percent of the reference group. Some jobs also use the TAPAS personality test or the Predictive Success Model (PSM), which are given separately.

Other Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship required
  • Secret security clearance eligibility
  • Must pass the Reading Aloud Test
  • Some ways into this job use TAPAS 2-factor, TAPAS, which is given separately from the ASVAB.

Related Air Force Jobs

  • 1W0X1 Weather G 66 and E 50
  • 1N0X1 All Source Intelligence Analyst PSM 26 and G 53, or G 55
  • 1Z1X1 Pararescue G 49
  • 2S0X1 Materiel Management A 41, or G 44
  • 3E7X1 Fire Protection G 57
